issue.title: Click an idle-agenda task row to open the task in Obsidian
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-66.7 note #1 (epic bob-cli-66 closeout follow-up, triaged by bob-cli-66.land). In Bob Mac Capture's idle agenda (empty draft), clicking a resolved task row opens that task in Obsidian through the existing ObsidianOpenURL helper. Use the row's bob-provided relative_target and block_id from bob capture-pomodoros --tasks. The app must stay a thin client: no vault reads. Focus and panel-dismiss behavior must be decided, and the row needs hover and accessibility affordances.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan plan:202610/idle_capture_pomodoro_agenda.md (epic bob-cli-66) settled the v1.1 agenda interactions as out of scope: keyboard focus never leaves the editor and rows are read-only in v1. The accepted decision decisions:idle-capture-shows-ledger-agenda lists row clicks, keyboard navigation, and ⌘1…9 insertion under 'Reopens when', so this work should revisit that record.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-66.7 recorded this v1.1 agenda interaction as a follow-up; the plan deliberately kept agenda rows inert in v1.
